keyTerms.definition: seq.blocks not cleared after eviction; reused object aliases freed blocks.
Allocate on schedule: the alternative fix.

recall.question: What is the paged-cache bug and the fix?
recall.answer: seq.blocks is not cleared after eviction, so a reused sequence object aliases freed blocks. Fix: clear the block list on evict (or allocate a fresh list on schedule).

keyTerms.definition: 25.6 GB without sharing versus 0.26 GB with sharing.
Or shared block pool: ~25 GB saved.

recall.question: Size the shared-prefix cache and decide.
recall.answer: Without sharing: 100·2000·128KB = 25.6 GB just for prefixes. With sharing: 0.26 GB. A prefix GPU (or shared block pool) is clearly worth it: about 25 GB saved.

recall.question: Name the three gaps in the serving paper and their closes.
recall.answer: (1) No batch size: throughput undefined, report it. (2) No length distribution: cache behavior unknown, report it. (3) No latency: throughput-only claims hide tails, report p99.
